note: Hand-written. These need a historical source in the Knowledge Base; the dataset only holds current CR versions. Every one starts reviewState=draft and must be verified against a dated Wizards article before it counts in the evaluation. Do NOT promote to verified from model memory.

questions.question: Can Mogg Fanatic assign combat damage, sacrifice itself in response, and still deal that combat damage?
questions.expectedVerdict: No, not under the current rules. Before the Magic 2010 rules change in July 2009 combat damage used the stack, so this worked. The activated ability relevant to this interaction did not materially change; the rules governing combat damage did.

questions.question: Before the 2009 combat damage change, could you animate Mishra's Factory after damage was put on the stack and still have it survive?
questions.expectedVerdict: DRAFT: requires the 2009 rules-change article and the pre-2009 CR. Not answerable from the current corpus.

questions.expectedVerdict: DRAFT: mana burn was removed by the Magic 2010 rules change. Requires a dated source before this counts.

questions.question: Under the rules as they stood in 2005, what happened to unspent mana from Black Lotus at end of phase?

questions.question: The printed card just says 'Bands'. What does the card actually do, and did its function change?
questions.expectedVerdict: The printed text is shorthand for banding, which the current Oracle text spells out in full. Measured text similarity is 0.025 but the function did not change. Oracle governs under CR 108.1.

questions.question: My Alpha Lightning Bolt says 'one target'. Can I still point it at a planeswalker?
questions.expectedVerdict: Yes. Current Oracle text reads 'any target', which includes planeswalkers and battles. Measured text similarity to the printed wording is 0.600, high, yet the function changed. Oracle governs under CR 108.1.
